source.repro: node --expose-gc plugins/alignments/benches/perBaseWall.probe.ts, on a 16-core machine at load 45. Drives the shipped extractPerBaseQuality, writing PerBaseColumns, over plugins/alignments/benches/pacbio_hg002.bam at 9:129,985,800-131,013,572 — 2,296 real PacBio CCS reads, ~1.03 Mb, about 33x depth — once per zoom tier, at that tier's subPixelBinBp. The region is the fixture's own span, so a 1000px canvas showing it sits at ~1028 bp/px — the bottom row is the zoom this fixture is actually looked at.
source.notes: Entry counts and retained memory are deterministic and repeat exactly; ms moves with machine load, and this run was at load 45, so read the ratio, not the absolute. heapMB is what the columns RETAIN once built (heapUsed plus arrayBuffers across a forced GC); the peak is higher by the doubling copy that holds two stores at once. The object-per-entry extract this replaced retained 2033.5 MB on the top row and 6.7 MB on the bottom, from the same entry counts.
